title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.17564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Governments are writing rules for artificial intelligence that decide what counts as an automated decision or a harm, often before the people they affect have a chance to question them. We introduce AI-Voyager, a public-interest system for human-AI civic reasoning, in which people and AI work together to understand, contest and shape the rules that govern AI. A resident can find their city's rules on AI in hiring or upload their country's AI strategy, read it as an affected worker would, open the passage behind any answer, and draft a revision. Its architecture turns 3,653 governance documents from city, state, federal and national governments into passages that keep their page and edition, and retrieves evidence through bounded agentic search that verifies each statement. On 360 new questions that require finding the relevant documents, it reached 83.0% macro recall, against 80.5% for the strongest baseline, 73.7% without iterative sear

translated_title: AI-Voyager：一个用于人机公民推理的公益系统，旨在质疑并塑造治理人工智能的规则
translated_abstract: 各国政府正在为人工智能制定规则，这些规则决定什么构成自动化决策或伤害，而往往在受影响的人们有机会质疑之前就已敲定。我们介绍了AI-Voyager，一个面向人机公民推理的公益系统，在其中人类与AI协同工作，以理解、质疑并塑造治理AI的规则。居民可以查找所在城市关于AI在招聘中使用的规则，或上传其国家的AI战略，像受影响的工人那样阅读这些内容，打开任何答案背后的原文段落，并起草修订建议。其架构将来自市、州、联邦和国家各级政府的3,653份治理文档转换为保留页码和版本的段落，并通过有界的智能体搜索检索证据，逐条验证每项陈述。在360个需要查找相关文档的新问题上，该系统达到83.0%的宏观召回率，而最强基线为80.5%，不使用迭代搜索时为73.7%。
tldr: AI-Voyager是一个公益性的“人机公民推理”系统，它将3,653份各级政府治理文档转化为可溯源的证据段落，让居民与AI协同理解、质疑并起草修订治理AI的规则，在文档检索评测中达到83.0%的宏观召回率。
en_tdlr: AI-Voyager is a public-interest human-AI civic reasoning system that transforms 3,653 government governance documents into traceable evidence passages, enabling residents to collaboratively understand, contest, and draft revisions to AI governance rules, achieving 83.0% macro recall on document retrieval benchmarks.
